title: Not Enough Minerals
description: Optimize robot-building order to maximize geode production within time limits.
writeup:
## Approach

For each blueprint, DFS over possible robot-building decisions. Instead of simulating minute-by-minute, skip forward to the earliest time each robot type can be built (based on current resource production rates). Prune with an upper bound: current geodes plus best-case future production (building a geode robot every remaining minute).

## Part 1

Maximize geodes in 24 minutes for each blueprint. Sum `id × max_geodes` for the quality level.

## Part 2

Maximize geodes in 32 minutes for only the first 3 blueprints. Return their product. Additional pruning (capping robot counts at max needed per resource) keeps the search tractable.
